title: Edit your business profile and regional settings
summary: Update public identity, contact details, booking policies and local formats.

sections.title: Before making changes
sections.body: Use **Business setup → Business profile**. You need settings access for the whole business. Business identity is separate from your personal Profile & security information.

sections.title: Update the profile
sections.body:
1. Select **Identity & contact**. Review **Business name**, **Booking link**, **Business type**, **Accent colour**, **Business description**, **Public phone** and **Email**.
2. Use **Edit address & entrance** or **Add business address** to edit the location’s address.
3. Select **Region & money** to review **Country**, **Language & region**, **Currency** and **Time zone**, **Week starts**, **Appointment interval**, **Tax treatment** and **Default tax rate** when shown. Review whether prices include tax, tax is added at checkout, or the business is not tax registered.
4. Select **Client-facing policies** and review **Cancellation policy**, **Terms link** and **Privacy link** your clients will read.
5. Select **Save business profile**.

sections.title: Check the saved result
sections.body: Reopen the profile and review the public preview. Check contact links, currency and times before accepting appointments. Existing appointments retain their recorded policies; a profile edit does not rewrite their past details.

sections.title: Changing currency or time zone
sections.body: Changing the country can suggest new regional defaults. Review every suggestion before saving. Existing service prices retain their recorded currency; a business currency change does not convert old services or financial history. Check the specific location’s time zone when troubleshooting a booking time.
